themes.title: Electoral Realignment and Campaign Mobilization Strategies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in both Norway and the United States are demonstrating strong momentum through high-visibility mobilization and surging voter support. In the U.S., Donald Trump is conducting multi-state campaign rallies to energize the Republican base for midterms, while Norway's Progress Party (Frp) has reached unprecedented historic polling highs under Sylvi Listhaug.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump and Vance headline campaign rallies across battleground states including Alaska, Nebraska, and Texas to mobilize Republican voters.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Frp achieves a historic popularity peak at 31.9% support in national polling amid strong conservative campaign momentum.

themes.title: Inflation and Cost-of-Living Crises Fuel Right-Wing Campaigns
themes.blurb: Conservative leaders across borders are emphasizing energy policy interventions and relief measures to address voter dissatisfaction with high costs and economic uncertainty. In the U.S., officials are promoting fuel price relief through tax suspensions on diesel while addressing public economic strain, while Norway's Frp is actively reopening national policy debates on energy supply and oil sector stability.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: The administration proposes suspending diesel taxes and penalties to lower high fuel costs while acknowledging voter economic struggles.

countries.note: Frp reopens high-stakes energy supply debates to safeguard business interests and the oil and gas sector.
